Hi all I'm new here so I hope I am posting in the right section. I have a few stories to share so I'll separate them that way if you ask questions or comment then it can be easily understood. It goes back to approximately 2004 when I was about 12 years old.. My mother was with a man who was a manager of a sheep station in the middle of nowhere in central west NSW, Australia. We thought it would be nice to go out to the farm and stay there the night, ride the motorbikes, show off the sheep dog's tricks etc. My father in law lived there permanently and this was my first time spending the night there. The afternoon didn't begin well when a random (never seen before) black cat hissed and ran past me off into the shed. My mother said it was likely a feral cat and has not seen humans in a long time, nothing to worry about. My mother and I sat down in front of the old styled sliding up/down wooden window on the veranda whilst my father in law made us all some coffee. When he brought the coffee outside I felt that feeling like when someone is watching you, then BAM the window slammed behind my head.

Much later that night after dinner I was on my way to bed as mother was giving me a tour of the house, she explained that the owner's wife has a bedroom there that no one sleeps in and not to enter due to it had been untouched since she had died. Of course I entered her room, I was 12... and yes apparently she did die in that room.

So much to my joy I was sleeping in the spare room next to her room. I normally fall asleep quite quickly so when I couldn't go to sleep immediately I put my headphones in and listened to some music to fall asleep. I began to feel quite chilled so I pulled the blankets up further over my shoulders, again with this feeling that I was being watched. I slowly turned over and was compelled to look and check if someone was there. I froze still, I felt like I was paralyzed too scared to move and goosebumps ran over my body, my lips were tingling and I had a lump in my throat as I saw a large (fat) outlined lady standing in my doorway looking at me not sure if she was talking or if it was in my mind or telepathic or what but she was definitely making sure I was not welcome in her house. The outline was a blue/white colour, she was not hovering like a stereotypical ghost.. Just standing there looking at me. It gives me goosebumps now just thinking about it.
